mapper.select: SELECT p.PRD_CODE AS prdId , m.MAT_CODE AS matId , bi.bom_QTY AS matQty , bi.bom_UNIT AS matUnit , p.PRD_NAME , m.MAT_NAME FROM BOM_ITEM bi LEFT JOIN MATERIAL m ON bi.MAT_ID = m.MAT_ID LEFT JOIN BOM b ON b.bom_id = bi.bom_id LEFT JOIN PRODUCT p ON b.PRD_ID = p.PRD_ID WHERE b.PRD_ID = ( SELECT p.PRD_ID FROM PRODUCT p WHERE p.PRD_CODE = #{prdCode} ) AND b.USE_YN = 'Y'
